classes.element: Element dependency: the consumer renders the source element (registered by its define entry).
classes.controller: Shared controller: parts in the consumer's own tree with behaviour from a core controller or collection model.
classes.style: Shared style module or tokens: the consumer draws the decision from one shared module (no nested element).
classes.slot: Slot content: the author supplies it; no dependency.
classes.native: Native element: the platform draws it; no dependency.
classes.independent: Looks alike, independent: no shared decision.
classes.deferred: Not classified (data grid, deferred by the owner).

odd-action-approval.reason: Approve, reject, and edit are complete buttons (Figma: button ×2).

odd-button.reason: A simple component: no element, overlay, positioning, or collection dependency.

odd-calendar.reason: The month buttons and the Today and Clear actions are native buttons drawn with the small ghost button look; the date cells are the grid's own cells.

odd-change-review.reason: Accept, reject, and undo are complete buttons (Figma: button/sm ×2).

odd-checkbox-group.reason: The choices are complete odd-checkbox elements the author places; each is form-associated on its own, and the group adds the legend, description, error, and required-one rule.

odd-checkpoint.reason: Restore and confirm are complete buttons (Figma: button/sm ×1).

odd-combobox.reason: Rows, chips, and the clear button are parts drawn from the option-row, listbox, chip, and input sheets (one shadow tree: the input's aria-activedescendant names the options). The avatars view nests odd-avatar, a complete widget with no ID relationship across the boundary.

odd-command-palette.reason: Command icons are drawn by the complete odd-icon widget, as on odd-menu; rows are option-row parts in the dialog's one tree (the input's aria-activedescendant names them).

odd-conversation.reason: Renders one odd-message per message record and an odd-activity for run status; both are complete widgets authors also place alone, and no ARIA ID crosses (each labels itself). Repeated per message: the per-instance cost is measured in the lifetime harness.

odd-date-picker.reason: The popup holds a complete odd-calendar (a definition dependency) that shares the date picker’s value, bounds, first day, disabled-date hook, read-only state, and strings.

odd-dialog.reason: Actions and fields are slot content.

odd-drawer.reason: It extends odd-dialog's class and template; actions and fields are slot content.

odd-file-input.reason: The picker button is the native input's ::file-selector-button with the button look; the glyphs come from the shared glyph module.

odd-menu.reason: Item icons are drawn by the complete odd-icon widget authors also place alone.

odd-message.reason: A message renders the record parts it carries with the elements that own them (response, sources, tool calls, approvals, artifacts, branch, feedback, AI label) and odd-button for save/cancel while editing; each is a complete widget authors also place alone.

odd-model-select.reason: A styled native `<button>`; no listbox dependency.

odd-picker.reason: Tree item icons are drawn by the complete odd-icon widget authors also place alone; the avatars view nests odd-avatar, as on odd-combobox.

odd-prompt-input.reason: Send and stop are complete buttons (Figma: button ×1).

odd-question.reason: Submit and skip are complete buttons (Figma: button/sm ×2).

odd-response.reason: Inline citations are complete odd-citation widgets authors also place alone.

odd-response-feedback.reason: Submit and cancel are complete buttons (Figma: button/sm ×2).

odd-segmented-control.reason: Option icons are drawn by the complete odd-icon widget authors also place alone.

odd-side-nav.reason: Entries are parts rendered from the navigation item model.

odd-split-button.reason: The menu half is a complete odd-menu (Figma splitAction: a button and a Menu), with its keyboard, submenus, and odd-action events; the primary half is a native button part.

odd-stat.reason: The loading placeholder is the complete odd-skeleton widget (its pulse and reduced-motion rule), recoloured to the sunken surface; no ARIA relationship crosses its boundary.

odd-toast.reason: The action is the author's button in the end slot; the close button is the shared overlay control.

odd-tool-call.reason: A tool call that needs approval renders the complete odd-action-approval widget.

odd-tooltip.reason: It describes the element it is anchored to; the anchor is any element, not a dependency.

odd-tree.reason: Item icons are drawn by the complete odd-icon widget authors also place alone.

odd-validation-summary.reason: Its links point at the form's own controls; the danger look and glyph are the shared tone module.

odd-voice-input.reason: Shows the live odd-transcript widget authors also place alone.
